description: Publish draft to live. handoff required; feedback optional. Warnings (form_unwired, store, SEO) are advisory: tell the user. Site-check errors return a publish_issues decision. A request to publish is not agreement to publish those errors: use its publishWithIssues code only after the user has seen them and said to publish anyway; if you can't ask, fix them or stop and report. If a fix needs text or a link target you don't know, ask the user.

acknowledgeSeoWarnings.description: Only satisfies the brief seo=must block, never publish_issues.

confirmedDraftFingerprint.description: Required when get_draft_status returned requiredDecision (publish_confirm); the current fingerprint from get_draft_status.

feedback.description: Optional session feedback; tool intents are attached automatically.

category.description: missing_tool | blocking_error | extra_round_trips | confusing_response | workaround | other

handoff.description: One sentence: decisions, preferences, or open threads for the next session (appended to the brief).

onlyReady.description: Publish only changes marked ready (server hashes); not with pages. Skips the publish_confirm fingerprint.

pages.description: Publish only these pages (≤50 route paths, e.g. /pricing) — use when a publish returns rules_not_fully_checked; publish the rest in further batches.

publishWithIssues.description: The publish_issues code (see the tool description). true does not work.

name: publish_site
